_: What the web app's first paint may cost, and what a raise means. THREE quantities: the JS entry graph, the ceiling on any one lazy chunk, and the render-blocking CSS — the last added at the M5 gate pass, when the performance review found it measured in the report and read by nothing, under a docblock claiming to cover everything the browser parses first. See apps/web/scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs. A raise carries a one-line reason in `raisedBecause` — a budget quietly moved up is a budget that never says no.
measuredBy: pnpm exec vite build in apps/web (writes bundle-report.json), run at the head of the route code-splitting change (M1-M3), not origin/main. That is the stated exception to the rule this field used to carry, and it is for LOWERINGS only: a split that shrinks the entry graph by more than the headroom cannot be measured against main, which still holds the unsplit graph (docs/specs/route-code-splitting/feature-spec.md section 4). A raise is still measured against origin/main, or the branch under test sets its own bar.

floor._: The measurement the budget is derived from, kept so a later reader can see how much headroom has been spent without re-running the build. RE-FLOORED 2026-10-02 DOWNWARD by the route code-splitting epic (M1-M3), replacing the 2026-09-25 measurement of 445254 / 128584 / 15779, recorded here because `check-bundle-size.mjs` B7 reads a fixed key set and a `previousFloor` key would fail the gate. The entry graph fell 445254 -> 180121 (-265133 gzip) because the plan screens, the hierarchy, the libraries, the administration screens, the account screens and the authenticated frame left it, and with them the `paint` chunk. The per-chunk ceiling is set by jspdf (128583), unchanged; the largest application chunk is plan-detail at 92501.

headroomRatioIsAJudgement: 1.05 is a CHOICE, not a measurement (product-owner decision, docs/specs/delivery-gates/ CQ-2). It is about 20 kB gzip on the entry graph — room for an ordinary feature without a conversation, and not room for a library. There is no evidence behind the number; it is the smallest margin that does not make the gate fire on routine work.
